title: AI-Powered Medical Diagnosis System
description: Developed a deep learning model for early detection of diabetic retinopathy from retinal fundus images. Achieved 94.2% accuracy using a custom CNN architecture with transfer learning from ResNet-50.
longDescription: This project addresses the critical need for early detection of diabetic retinopathy, a leading cause of blindness worldwide. Using a dataset of 3,500 retinal images, I developed a convolutional neural network that achieves clinical-grade accuracy. The system features an intuitive web interface for ophthalmologists to upload images and receive instant AI-assisted diagnoses.

title: Multilingual Sentiment Analysis Tool
description: Built a multilingual sentiment analysis pipeline supporting Urdu, English, and Arabic using fine-tuned mBERT. Processes 10,000+ social media posts per minute with real-time dashboard.
longDescription: Sentiment analysis in low-resource languages like Urdu presents unique challenges due to limited training data and complex morphology. This project fine-tuned the multilingual BERT model on custom-labeled datasets for Urdu, English, and Arabic social media text. The system includes a real-time monitoring dashboard for brands and researchers.

title: Distributed Task Scheduling System
description: Designed and implemented a fault-tolerant distributed task scheduler supporting 50,000+ concurrent jobs using consistent hashing and leader election via Raft consensus algorithm.
longDescription: This distributed systems project tackles the challenge of scheduling millions of tasks across a cluster of nodes. Implemented in Go for high performance, the system uses consistent hashing for load balancing, the Raft algorithm for leader election, and PostgreSQL for persistent state. Supports job priorities, dependencies, retries, and real-time monitoring.

title: Smart Campus Navigation App
description: Cross-platform mobile app for indoor/outdoor navigation on university campus. Features real-time crowd density maps and accessibility routing for differently-abled students.
longDescription: Addressing the challenge of navigating large university campuses, this Flutter app combines Google Maps with custom indoor mapping to guide students to classrooms, offices, and facilities. A machine learning model predicts crowd density based on historical data and class schedules, helping students plan efficient routes.

title: Blockchain-based Academic Credential System
description: Decentralized platform for issuing and verifying academic credentials on Ethereum blockchain. Eliminates degree fraud with immutable, publicly verifiable certificates.
longDescription: Academic credential fraud is a global problem. This project implements a decentralized credential system on the Ethereum blockchain where universities can issue tamper-proof digital certificates that employers can verify instantly. Smart contracts handle the issuance logic, while a user-friendly React frontend makes verification accessible to non-technical users.

title: Real-time Collaborative Code Editor
description: VS Code-like collaborative editor supporting 20+ languages with real-time sync, video calling, and AI code suggestions powered by GPT-4.
longDescription: Built for remote pair programming, this web-based IDE uses operational transformation for conflict-free collaborative editing. Features include syntax highlighting for 20+ languages, integrated video calling via WebRTC, AI-powered code completion using the OpenAI API, and version history.
